name: Change Yoshi's color
description: Paints the Yoshi Mario rides ($187A) in another color, by writing the palette byte of his sprite (!15F6, $15F6 without SA-1): $0A yellow, $0B blue, $0C red, $0D green, as the Yoshi color blocks of the archive (SMWC 15392 and 34003) do. His slot comes from $18E2. Nothing happens when Mario is not on Yoshi.
author: BlockCreator
